name: Ball Slam
instructions: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, holding a medicine ball overhead.
Slam the ball into the floor as hard as you can, hinging at the hips.
Catch it on the bounce (or pick it up) and immediately reload.
A full-body power and conditioning exercise. Use a non-bouncing slam ball.
longevityNotes: A stable trunk protects the spine through every decade. Train the core for endurance and control rather than chasing burn.
overview: Ball Slam is a beginner core exercise targeting the abs, performed with minimal equipment. A strong trunk stabilizes every lift and protects the spine in daily life.
